$description: The Vault (components/vault/*) in the scratch library's Vault (apps/mac/scripts/screens.mjs VAULT_FIXTURE, PIN 246813): locked, Files & Notes, Passwords & Credentials, Health, Trash and Settings. Every value here is read inside .ui-invert, so it is the other theme's: the native Vault draws them with its scheme flipped back (VaultStyle).

prepare.files: const wait = async (fn) => { for (let t = 0; t < 20000; t += 100) { const v = fn(); if (v) return v; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } }; const byText = (s, x) => [...document.querySelectorAll(s)].find((e) => e.textContent.trim() === x); const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find((l) => l.textContent.trim().startsWith('Passcode'))?.querySelector('input'); if (f) { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(f, '246813'); f.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); byText('button', 'Unlock').click(); await wait(() => document.querySelector("[role='tablist']")); } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); byText("[role='tab']", 'Files & Notes').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); return true;
